summary: Ramesh Srinivasan is President and CEO of Agilysys.
Agilysys reported record full fiscal year 2026 revenue of $319.3 million, including 30.2% year-over-year subscription revenue growth.

The Inn at Little Washington deployed Agilysys Versa PMS, InfoGenesis POS and related tools to unify dining, lodging and retail operations; Angel of the Winds expanded its Agilysys footprint in September 2026 to include InfoGenesis 12UX, IG OnDemand and IG Kiosk for food-and-beverage point of sale. (Scope note: These are hospitality/resort accounts (F&B POS attached to a broader PMS deal), not standalone restaurant-chain wins.)
